catches: Discounts vary by brand and market supply; deep discounts (up to 35%) skew toward less popular brands.
45-day money-back guarantee only applies if you use the card within 45 days of purchase — report problems fast.
Digital cards usually arrive within 24 hours but can take longer; don't buy at the register.
Physical cards ship free via USPS in 5-7 days — too slow for immediate needs.
Check the balance immediately on arrival; review sources note occasional zero-balance issues on delayed use.
